capabilities: Compute Year, Month, Day and Hour pillars from birth data
Calibrate true solar time from a 400+ city database
Analyze Ten Gods, Dayun, Liunian, Liuyue and Xiaoyun
Render charts in code blocks, a sidebar view and a left panel
Save charts as Markdown case files with YAML frontmatter
disambiguation: Not a file compression or zip tool; it calculates Bazi (Four Pillars) astrology charts.
extras: Bilingual Chinese/English README; can be installed through BRAT; results may differ from other calculators because of differing algorithm parameters such as Fortune start rules and solar term timing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to compute Bazi charts or keep them next to related notes, so charts had to be produced in external calculators and copied in by hand.

relations.evidence: This plugin is based on the paipan.js engine with transparent and traceable algorithms.

summary: Bazi (Four Pillars) calculator that computes a birth chart from date, time and gender and shows it in a sidebar, left panel or code block.
